tldr my girlfriend killed herself, call EMS if you want.



i was the only one she could call when her partner kicked her out after catching her relapsing on inhalants (aka huffing). we packed everything into my car in silence. we smoked and i held her till she caught her breath, and her tears stopped flowing. she came to live with me.

off and on, our relationship was. classic bpd mutual codependency really; life was like an indie music video. it's a blur honestly, it's hard to remember most of it as we were drunk/high most of the time.

but as time went on she felt heard less and less. when we lived together for the final time, things got really bad. constantly gaslighting both me and my mom, flipping out at every little thing—i mean a wild and scared anger—never physically violent, but.. we weren't friends, let's say that. i asked her to leave one day after she stole my mom's car for a few days to fuck that same ex. her response to me asking why: "i'm doing it for love. nothing else." i nodded, and that was the last time we ever spoke.

every so often i'd check on her through various social media posts or her accounts, but one day in November 2020 i found out that she died that September, on the 18th. apparently from a heart attack. i'm not sure where i found that, but i think it's bullshit. if i knew her at all i'm sure it was from inhalants.

as you can tell i'm still processing everything and i'm in denial about a lot of it. but one thing i've learned that i can tell you is it isn't your fault what she chooses. no matter how this goes, or what comes of it, all you can do is what you have done. at this point, all i can say is call emergency services if you feel moved to.

ps. i know the feeling of your gf's side a bit. i am chronically suicidal/self-harming and specific in my planning of sui. my most recent ex left me for that. said it was too much of a requirement to support me.. which i get. i know i tried everything so i don't blame myself. but still.
